title: You gave me a u32. I gave you root. (io_uring ZCRX freelist LPE)
summary: A detailed security research article demonstrating exploitation of a use-after-free vulnerability in the Linux kernel's io_uring ZCRX freelist mechanism to achieve local privilege escalation from a regular user to root.
problem_solved: Exploits a race condition and freelist corruption vulnerability in io_uring to gain root privileges on a Linux system.
why_valuable: Provides deep insights into modern Linux kernel exploitation techniques and helps the security community understand and defend against such privilege escalation attacks.
